summary: This joint resolution blocks the Department of Energy rule setting new energy conservation standards for consumer gas-fired instantaneous water heaters by declaring the rule has no force or effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill nullifies a rule that would have established amended energy conservation standards for gas-fired instantaneous water heaters, which were intended to improve energy efficiency. By nullifying these standards, the bill effectively reduces environmental protection efforts related to energy consumption, making this topic central to the bill's purpose.
